app.name: Imposter Party
onboarding.1.title: Instant fun everywhere!
onboarding.1.body: Game night, road trip, even a weird first date — Imposter Party breaks the ice and starts the fun.
onboarding.2.title: Who's faking it?
onboarding.2.body: One of you is lying. The rest know the word. Can you find the imposter before it's too late?
onboarding.3.title: Speak smart. Guess well.
onboarding.3.body: Describe the secret word without saying it. Careful — the imposter is listening and trying to blend in.
tutorial.1.title: Pick themes
tutorial.1.body: Choose one or more themes that fit the mood and your party.
tutorial.2.title: Check your role
tutorial.2.body: Everyone sees the secret word… except the imposter — they only see their role. Their goal? Blend in.
tutorial.3.title: Give a hint
tutorial.3.body: Give a clever hint or association. Clear for those who know — confusing for the imposter.
tutorial.4.title: Time to vote
tutorial.4.body: Talking is over. Vote to expose the imposter!
tutorial.4.warning: If the imposter guesses the word before time runs out, they win instantly
